seaman game sourced

Seaman

A Dreamcast virtual pet in which the player talks through a microphone to a sardonic human-faced fish, managing its tank's heat, water, and food while it matures through five life stages.

1999VivariumVirtual petcluster c138 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

check the tank each real day -> adjust heat, clean water, and feed -> talk to Seaman through the microphone -> it learns words and asks about the player -> the life stage advances through breeding and die-off -> raise the Frogman generation and release it

design notes

Yoot Saito built Seaman around speech: a microphone accessory lets the player answer questions and make small talk, early Gillmen repeat the player's words back as gibberish, and the creature's vocabulary grows while it keeps insulting the player. The care loop is sparse but strict, with roughly one check per real day needed to keep it alive, so the game paces itself to the player's calendar. Its life cycle is scripted and harsh: Gillmen fight until two remain, Podfish die after mating, Tadmen eat each other until two remain, and the final Frogmen are released into the wild. Leonard Nimoy narrates the English version as a guide who explains only part of the rules.

8 stored edges
uses

Creature care

The player sets tank heat, cleans dirty water, and supplies food, and later runs a sprinkler to keep Frogmen moist.

core
uses

Lifecycle and aging

Mushroomer, Gillman, Podfish, Tadman, and Frogman stages; Podfish parents die after mating and the aquarium becomes a terrarium.

core
uses

Natural-language interaction

Microphone speech is matched against the creature's current vocabulary; it asks for the player's birthday and other details and answers in conversation.

core
uses

Real-time clock

Time follows the real calendar; going much longer than a day without a check can kill the creature.

core
uses

Creature learning

Vocabulary grows through conversation, and the creature becomes tamer over time.

supporting
uses

Habitat suitability

Tank temperature and water cleanliness must suit the current life stage.

supporting
uses

Memories and thoughts

It remembers facts the player shares, such as a birthday, and later tells historical events from that date.

supporting
uses

Permadeath

A neglected creature dies permanently.
